name: starflask_create_job
description: Create an arbitrary Starflask job by type — the general-purpose equivalent of `npx starflask jobs create <type>`. Use this for job types without a dedicated tool: "image:upscale", "image:remove_bg", "image:vectorize", "vector:generate", "image:cartoonify", and subtypes like "image:resize", "image:crop". Returns a job id immediately — poll with starflask_get_job until 'completed', then read the relevant URL from result. Set `type`, a `model_key` (see starflask_list_models), and whichever of `prompt` / `image_url` the job needs (most transform jobs take an image_url pointing at media you uploaded via starflask_upload_media). Prefer starflask_generate_image / _video / _3d / _speech for those four common cases.

model_key.description: The model key to use (from starflask_list_models).

image_url.description: Optional input image/media URL the job operates on (from starflask_upload_media or a prior job result).

prompt.description: Optional text prompt, for job types that take one.
